Adding the same skip‑link markup to every page would guarantee keyboard users can bypass navigation on any page. 3. **Copy‑URL on the homepage** – the index page has many copy buttons (stats, schedule, etc.) but **lacks a “Copy URL” button** for the homepage itself, which is a common convenience feature present on all other pages. 4. **Live “Last updated” badge** – the badge on every page shows a static timestamp from `stats.json`.
